svg.aria-label: The packages in layers, highest first. cmd holds the program, which runs where it is started or hands over to wsl-shrinker.exe. front holds cli, tui, ui and i18n. app puts the rest together, and remote is the screen's link to wsl-shrinker.exe from inside WSL. engine holds disks, estimate, survey, shrink, journal and history. settings holds config. machine holds wsl, winapi, vhdx and ext4. core holds units and version, and does no I/O. Imports go down the layers, never up.
